## Is this a new driver template or a tool feature?

- [ ] New driver template (subsystem: e.g. hwmon / leds / input / net / USB)
- [ ] Generator / CLI feature
- [ ] Documentation

## Describe the use case

What device or driver pattern should be generated? What does a user
currently have to do by hand?

## Reference material

Links to:
- existing in-tree drivers that follow the desired pattern
- datasheet / device documentation (if hardware-specific)
- kernel docs or mailing list discussions

## Additional context

Anything else relevant.
